item.description:

item.title: Hungary: Communist-era files released, up to 60k former agents revealed
item.description:
📝 In total, estimates suggest 50,000 to 60,000 agent names were made public over all this document disclosure. The public has free access since Wednesday to this data via a search tool that can filter by birth data, by name, place and date of birth, as well as by code name, across all types of records that have been made public. Around 150,000 agents during communist era Hungary was under one-party communist rule between 1949 and 1989 that repressed dissent.
🔗 Read more: https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/04/hungary-communist-era-files-opened-up-to-60000-former-agents-revealed
